# Erik Cason

> I write in public as a way of thinking. A personal philosophical terrain of essays, news, spoken work, video, and books.

Erik Cason is a philosopher, entrepreneur, and systems thinker working at the intersection of cryptography, political philosophy, and economic coordination. Author of Cryptosovereignty: The Encrypted Political Philosophy of Bitcoin (Bitcoin Magazine Books, 2023). Co-founder and president of Vora (https://vora.io).

## The book

- [Cryptosovereignty: The Encrypted Political Philosophy of Bitcoin](https://erikcason.com/book/): A philosophy of Bitcoin as an emergent political order grounded in property, cryptography, and non-violent coordination. ISBN 979-8-9857289-7-2.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Cryptosovereignty-Encrypted-Political-Philosophy-Bitcoin/dp/B0CFCW6JJR)
- [Buy from Bitcoin Magazine](https://store.bitcoinmagazine.com/products/cryptosovereignty)

## Writing

- [The Declaration of Independence of Cyberintelligence](https://erikcason.com/writing/declaration-of-independence-of-cyberintelligence.html): A declaration for persons to own, inspect, and govern their own cyberintelligence.
- [Stateless Money to Stateless Society](https://erikcason.com/writing/stateless-money-to-stateless-society.html): Bitcoin is the first successful instance of money that does not require the state to exist.
- [Nyms, Anons, and Knowns](https://erikcason.com/writing/nyms-anons-knowns.html): On identity, legibility, and survival in the technopocene.
- [The Personal Responsibility of Bitcoin](https://erikcason.com/writing/the-personal-responsibility-of-bitcoin.html): Why the only way to change the world is to take responsibility for ourselves first.
